events.narrative: Steady moderate to heavy rain led to flooding of several roads and areas across mainly the central portions of Navarro County. Portions of I-45 were flooded, too, and the water approached a few homes. Within the flooding, a period of heavy rain caused Flash Flooding.

Arkansas Department of Transportation reported Highway 85 was closed for approximately 10 miles from Highway 44 to Highway 49. Highway 318 was closed for approximately five miles from Highway 85 to Highway 44, west of Helena - West Helena due to high water.
